messages.subject: error in GGIR
parts:
Good morning.

For the last few years I have used this accelerometry script with previous versions of the R program. When updating the program and the packages, it works but the data is wrong. The following message also appears:

 

Warning message:

In g.IVIS(Xi, epochsizesecondsXi = ws3, IVIS_epochsize_seconds = params_247[["IVIS_epochsize_seconds"]],  :

  Argument IVIS_epochsize_seconds has been depricated and has been ignored.

 

Could you help me?

I enclose the script.

Thank you very much

 

 

#-----------------------------------------------------#

#                     NOTES

# The following notes should be retained regarding the data:

# R Version: 3.6.1

# GGIR Version: 1.10-7

#-----------------------------------------------------#

 

#-----------------------------------------------------#

#                     INSTALL

# Calls required packages and installs if needed.

#-----------------------------------------------------#

 

checkpack <- function(pkg){

  new.pkg <- pkg[!(pkg %in% installed.packages()[, "Package"])]

  if (length(new.pkg))

    install.packages(new.pkg, dependencies = TRUE)

  sapply(pkg, require, character.only = TRUE)

}

 

packages <- c("GGIR", "MASS", "signal", "zoo", "mmap", "bitops", "matlab",

              "GENEAread", "tuneR", "stringr")

checkpack(packages)

 

#-----------------------------------------------------#

# SETUP

#-----------------------------------------------------#

  #=====================

  strategy = 3,

  #hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,

  maxdur = 0,                 includedaycrit = 0,

  qwindow=c(0,24),

  winhr = c(5,10),

  qlevels = c(c(1380/1440),c(1410/1440)),

  IVIS_epochsize_seconds =60,

  #=====================

  boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: error in GGIR
parts:
Hi Yesenia,

Not sure why you say that the data are wrong, are you getting unexpected output? As for the warning (it is not an error), I think it is self-explicative: in the GGIR version you are using, the argument "IVIS_epochsize_seconds" is deprecated and not used anymore, so you should remove this from your function call and from your configuration file to stop receiving this warning. You may want to look at the argument "IVIS_windowsize_minutes" in the documentation instead (default = 60).

Best,
Jairo
